title: GitHub - zamarrowski/claudemon: Wild Pokemon appear while you work in Claude Code.
excerpt: Wild Pokemon appear while you work in Claude Code. - zamarrowski/claudemon
content_html:
Wild Pokemon appear while you work in Claude Code. Your prompts are steps through the grass: the longer the prompt, the further you walk, and the more chances something jumps out. So is the waiting — every twenty seconds Claude spends working is another step, because that is the half of the session you actually have free.

The walking happens while Claude does, not the moment you press enter: a prompt buys you the steps and the turn takes them, so anything that jumps out does it with the grass already moving.

One at a time, and only for half a minute: a Pokemon that appears while you are busy wanders off if you leave it there, so a long session never leaves a queue of battles waiting for you.

The original 151. Fully local — no account, no backend, nothing about you leaving the machine.

It lives in a terminal tab of its own, next to the one you work in. The status line in Claude tells you something is waiting; the game tab is where you go and fight it.

┌─ Terminal 1: claude ──────────────────────────────────┐
│ > refactor this component                             │
│ ███████░░░░░░░ 63% left | Opus 5                      │
│ ✦ A wild PIDGEY appeared!  ·  24s left  ·  claudemon  │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Install

Typed inside Claude Code. Nothing to clone.

/plugin marketplace add zamarrowski/claudemon
/plugin install claudemon@claudemon

That puts the plugin in place — the hooks that make Pokemon appear come from it.

Now restart Claude Code. Claude Code only picks up a plugin's commands and hooks at startup, so until you restart, the next line does not exist yet — if you type it straight after installing, nothing happens. Once you are back:

/claudemon-setup

This does the rest: the claudemon command, the status line, and the sprites. It prints a line per step and says so if one of them did not work.

Then two one-offs, which it reminds you of:

  1. Restart Claude Code once more, so the new status line loads.
  2. In a second terminal tab, run claudemon.

It asks for a name and a starter the first time, and after that it sits there waiting. Send a longish prompt in the Claude tab and watch the status line.

What you need first

How to check
Claude Code You are already in it
Node.js 18 or newer node --version. The game and the hooks run on it, and Claude Code ships as its own binary so it does not bring one. Nothing else to install — no dependencies, no build step
A terminal with truecolor iTerm2, Ghostty, WezTerm, Kitty, Alacritty, VS Code's terminal and macOS Terminal are all fine

The 151 Pokemon ship with the plugin, so the only thing the install downloads is the sprites — 1.2 MB, a few seconds. After that the only thing that ever goes out is the version check below, and nothing goes out at all with it switched off.

Updating

The version this is sits at the right-hand end of the home screen's bottom row. Once a day the game asks GitHub whether a newer one is out — a plain GET of the plugin manifest, about 300 bytes, sending nothing. If there is, the home screen says so:

◆ v0.7.0 is out · [u] update

u does it: it refreshes the marketplace, fetches the new version through claude plugin update, and reruns the installer to catch anything around the plugin that changed. Then two one-offs, which it tells you about — restart Claude Code so the new hooks and status line load, and relaunch claudemon, because a running process cannot swap its own code out.

Option says when that question gets asked. UPDATE DAILY is the default above. UPDATE LAUNCH asks every time claudemon starts instead — one request as the tab comes up, and none while you play, which is what you want if you leave a tab open for a week and would rather not wait a day to hear about a release. UPDATE OFF stops it entirely: nothing is offered and no socket is opened; the two commands under Coming from 0.5.0 below still work whenever you want them.

Updating through Claude Code instead is fine too. The claudemon command is kept pointing at whichever copy is newest — by a hook, because neither the command nor the status line can be rewritten by hand once they are on a PATH and in settings.json — so the game picks the new one up on its next start, and says ◆ v0.7.0 is installed until you restart it.

Coming from 0.5.0

0.5.0 has none of this in it, so it cannot tell you a new version is out: the first upgrade is the only one you do by hand. In a terminal — not at the Claude Code prompt, because /plugin has no update of its own; this lives in the CLI:

claude plugin marketplace update claudemon
claude plugin update claudemon@claudemon

The first line is not optional. Your copy of the marketplace is whatever it was when you added it, so without refreshing it the second line has nothing newer to find and tells you so.

Restart Claude Code, then run claudemon again. That is all of it — the version turns up in the bottom-right corner, and [u] does every upgrade after this one.

There is one thing 0.5.0 leaves behind that has to be undone, and it undoes itself. 0.5.0's installer wrote the directory it was installed from into both launchers and nothing ever revisited it; for a plugin install that path has 0.5.0 in it, so the command would go on starting 0.5.0 whatever else you installed — in silence, the only symptom being a game that never changes. The first prompt after the restart puts both right, and notes it in ~/.claudemon/claudemon.log. A clone is left alone, because a clone is meant to take precedence.

Uninstall

/plugin uninstall claudemon@claudemon

That stops the hooks. To also remove the command and put your status line back, run the installer's undo — from the plugin copy, before you uninstall it:

node "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/tools/install.mjs" --uninstall

Your save is left alone either way — delete ~/.claudemon/ as well to be rid of it.

From a clone instead

For hacking on it, a clone works the same way and takes precedence over the installed copy:

git clone https://github.com/zamarrowski/claudemon
cd claudemon
node tools/install.mjs

That does everything the steps above do, including installing the plugin from the clone — so it needs no slash commands and only one restart, at the end. Keep the directory where it is: the launcher prefers it while it exists.

Controls

Arrow keys move, enter confirms, esc goes back, q quits. Any key advances a battle message. That is the whole scheme — it is the same everywhere.

Screen What it does
Home Whatever is in the grass and how long is left to face it, your team, and the menu
Battle FIGHT / BAG / POKÉMON / RUN, with move types, power and PP. A ◓ by the foe's name means it is already in your Pokédex
Pokédex All 151, with base stats and evolution requirements for the ones you caught
Team Details, moves, experience, enter to change your lead, and d to send one to the box
Box Everything you caught with a full team, reached with b from the team screen. enter takes one back into the team
Shop Balls, potions, revives and evolution stones. 5 buys five
Option How big sprites are drawn, the menu sounds, the bell, and when the version check runs — daily, every launch, or never. ← → changes a setting, and the Pokémon underneath redraws as you do

What is in it

  • The original 151, with real base stats, types, catch rates and Red/Blue movesets.
  • Battles with critical hits, the type chart, status conditions, PP, one-hit KOs, fleeing and switching Pokémon mid-fight.
  • Catching, where weakening and status genuinely help.
  • Levelling, learning moves, and evolution by level or by stone.
  • A Pokédex tracking seen and caught separately, a team screen with the box behind it, and a shop.
  • A line telling you whether Claude is working, which tool it is on and for how long — and a bell when it finishes or gets stuck on a permission prompt, so the game tab is somewhere you can actually sit and wait.
  • A patch of grass with someone walking through it, who only walks while Claude is working. Something you can catch out of the corner of your eye.
  • Blips as you move through the menus, and a theme that plays from the first frame of a battle to the last — off in one place if you would rather work in silence. The blips are generated from a few lines of notes rather than shipped, so a new one costs three numbers; the theme is two minutes of mono WAV in assets/, which is the one format every player on every platform will open.

Credits

Data and sprites come from PokeAPI. The stats and movesets in data/ are built from it by tools/fetch-data.mjs. The sprites are not in here: they are somebody else's artwork, so they are downloaded at install time rather than redistributed.

assets/battle.wav is the trainer battle theme from the Game Boy games, trimmed to two minutes and downmixed to mono. It is not original to this repo and it is not covered by the LICENSE, which applies to the code.

Pokemon is a trademark of Nintendo, Creatures Inc. and GAME FREAK Inc.; this is a personal, non-commercial toy.

content_html_zh:
当您在克劳德代码中工作时，野生神奇宝贝会出现。 你的提示是穿过草地的步骤：提示越长，你走得越远，东西跳出来的机会就越大。 等待也是如此——克劳德每工作二十秒就又迈出了一步，因为那是你实际上有空闲时间的一半。

行走是在克劳德行走时发生的，而不是在你按下回车键的那一刻发生的：提示会为你购买步数，然后轮流采取这些步数，因此任何跳出的东西都是在草已经移动的情况下进行的。

一次一个，而且只有半分钟：当你忙碌时出现的神奇宝贝如果你把它留在那里，它就会消失，所以长时间的会话永远不会留下一长串的战斗等着你。

原151. 完全本地化——没有帐户，没有后端，与您离开机器无关。

它位于自己的终端选项卡中，位于您工作的终端选项卡旁边。 Claude 的状态栏告诉你有事情正在等待；游戏选项卡是你去战斗的地方。

┌─ Terminal 1: claude ──────────────────────────────────┐
│ > refactor this component                             │
│ ███████░░░░░░░ 63% left | Opus 5                      │
│ ✦ A wild PIDGEY appeared!  ·  24s left  ·  claudemon  │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

安装

在克劳德代码中输入。 没有什么可克隆的。

/plugin marketplace add zamarrowski/claudemon
/plugin install claudemon@claudemon

这使得插件就位——让 Pokemon 出现的钩子就来自它。

现在重新启动克劳德代码。 Claude Code 仅在启动时获取插件的命令和挂钩，因此在重新启动之前，下一行还不存在 - 如果您在安装后直接键入它，则不会发生任何事情。 一旦你回来：

/claudemon-setup

这将完成剩下的工作：claudemon 命令、状态行和精灵。 它每一步打印一行，如果其中一个不起作用，它会这样说。

然后是两个一次性的，它让你想起：

  1. 再次重新启动 Claude Code，以便加载新的状态行。
  2. 在第二个终端选项卡中，运行 claudemon。

它第一次询问名字和开胃菜，之后它就坐在那里等待。 在 Claude 选项卡中发送较长的提示并观察状态行。

首先你需要什么

如何检查
克劳德·科德 你已经在其中了
Node.js 18 或更高版本 节点——版本。 游戏和挂钩在其上运行，并且 Claude Code 作为自己的二进制文件提供，因此它不附带任何二进制文件。 无需安装其他任何东西 - 没有依赖项，没有构建步骤
真彩色终端 iTerm2、Ghostty、WezTerm、Kitty、Alacritty、VS Code 的终端和 macOS 终端都可以

151 个 Pokemon 附带了该插件，因此安装下载的唯一内容是精灵 - 1.2 MB，几秒钟。 之后，唯一消失的是下面的版本检查，并且关闭后什么也不会消失。

更新中

该版本位于主屏幕底行的右端。 游戏每天都会询问 GitHub 是否有新版本发布——一个简单的插件清单 GET，大约 300 字节，不发送任何内容。 如果有，主屏幕会这样显示：

◆ v0.7.0 is out · [u] update

你这样做：它刷新市场，通过克劳德插件更新获取新版本，并重新运行安装程序以捕获插件周围发生更改的任何内容。 然后，它会告诉您两个一次性事件 - 重新启动 Claude Code，以便加载新的钩子和状态行，然后重新启动 claudemon，因为正在运行的进程无法交换自己的代码。

选项表示何时提出该问题。 每日更新是上面的默认值。 每次 claudemon 启动时，UPDATE LAUNCH 都会询问——标签出现时会发出一个请求，而在你玩游戏时则不会发出请求，如果你将标签打开一周并且不想等一天才听到发布消息，这就是你想要的。 UPDATE OFF 完全停止它：没有提供任何内容，也没有打开套接字；下面的来自 0.5.0 下的两个命令仍然可以在您需要时使用。

通过 Claude Code 进行更新也可以。 claudemon 命令通过钩子一直指向最新的副本，因为命令和状态行一旦位于 PATH 和 settings.json 中就无法手动重写，因此游戏会在下次启动时选择新的副本，并显示 ◆ v0.7.0 已安装，直到您重新启动它。

来自0.5.0

0.5.0 中没有这些内容，因此它无法告诉您新版本已经发布：第一次升级是您手动执行的唯一升级。 在终端中 — 不是在 Claude Code 提示符下，因为 /plugin 没有自己的更新；这存在于 CLI 中：

claude plugin marketplace update claudemon
claude plugin update claudemon@claudemon

第一行不是可选的。 您的市场副本是您添加它时的内容，因此无需刷新它，第二行就找不到任何新内容并告诉您这一点。

重新启动 Claude Code，然后再次运行 claudemon。 这就是全部 - 版本出现在右下角，[u] 执行此后的每一次升级。

0.5.0 留下了一件必须撤消的事情，而且它会自行撤消。 0.5.0 的安装程序将其安装目录写入两个启动器中，并且没有任何内容重新访问过它；对于插件安装，该路径中包含 0.5.0，因此该命令将继续启动 0.5.0，无论您安装了什么其他内容 - 默默地，唯一的症状是游戏永远不会改变。 重新启动后的第一个提示将两者都正确，并将其记录在 ~/.claudemon/claudemon.log 中。 克隆被保留，因为克隆意味着优先。

卸载

/plugin uninstall claudemon@claudemon

这会阻止钩子。 要删除该命令并恢复状态行，请在卸载之前从插件副本中运行安装程序的撤消操作：

node "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/tools/install.mjs" --uninstall

不管怎样，你的保存都会被保留——删除 ~/.claudemon/ 也可以摆脱它。

来自克隆

对于黑客攻击，克隆的工作方式相同，并且优先于已安装的副本：

git clone https://github.com/zamarrowski/claudemon
cd claudemon
node tools/install.mjs

这完成了上述步骤的所有操作，包括从克隆安装插件 - 因此它不需要斜杠命令，最后只需要重新启动一次。 将目录保留在原来的位置：启动器在它存在时更喜欢它。

控制

方向键移动，enter确认，esc返回，q退出。 任意键都会推进战斗信息。 这就是整个计划——到处都是一样的。

屏幕 它的作用
Home 无论草丛里有什么，还有多久才能面对它、你的团队和菜单
战斗 FIGHT / BAG / POKÉMON / RUN，有招式、力量和PP。 敌人名字旁边的 ◓ 表示它已经在你的图鉴中了
图鉴 所有 151 个，以及您捕获的那些的基本统计数据和进化要求
Team 详细信息、动作、经验，输入以更改您的领先优势，然后按 d 将其发送到盒子中
Box 你在整个团队中捕捉到的所有内容，都可以从团队屏幕上用 b 到达。 Enter 将一名成员带回团队
Shop 球、药水、复活石和进化石。 5 买 5
选项 绘制多大的精灵、菜单声音、铃声以及何时运行版本检查 - 每天、每次启动或从不运行。 ← → 更改设置，下面的神奇宝贝会像您一样重新绘制

里面有什么

  • 最初的 151，具有真实的基础统计数据、类型、捕获率和红/蓝移动设置。
  • 战斗中的暴击、类型表、状态条件、PP、一击KO、战斗中逃跑和切换神奇宝贝。
  • 捕捉，削弱和地位真正有帮助。
  • 升级、学习动作以及按等级或按石头进化。
  • 单独看到和捕获的图鉴追踪、后面有盒子的团队屏幕和一家商店。
  • 一条线告诉你克劳德是否正在工作，它正在使用哪个工具以及持续了多长时间——当它完成或卡在权限提示上时会有一个铃声，所以游戏选项卡是你实际上可以坐下来等待的地方。
  • 一片草地，有人在其中行走，而这个人只在克劳德工作时行走。 你可以用眼角的余光捕捉到的东西。
  • 当你在菜单中移动时会出现提示，并且从战斗的第一帧到最后一帧都会播放一个主题 - 如果你宁愿安静地工作，就在一个地方关闭。 这些光点是由几行笔记生成的，而不是发货的，因此一张新的光点要花费三个数字；主题是 asset/ 中的两分钟单声道 WAV，这是每个平台上的每个玩家都会打开的一种格式。

制作人员

数据和精灵来自 PokeAPI。 data/ 中的统计数据和移动集是由 tools/fetch-data.mjs 构建的。 精灵不在这里：它们是其他人的艺术作品，因此它们是在安装时下载的，而不是重新分发的。

asset/battle.wav 是 Game Boy 游戏中的训练师战斗主题，剪裁为两分钟并缩混为单声道。 它不是此存储库的原创内容，并且不受适用于代码的许可证的涵盖。
